lines.text: Staging systems are full of real people.
Click what should never leave this machine.
It is covered by a solid block, not blurred.
It survives the reload, the screenshot and the video.
The words underneath never reach the report, the clipboard, or a locator.
Put it back to sleep and nothing is watched, hooked or read.
Sleep stops the work, not the permission, and Settings takes the permission back.

lines.delivery: warm, unhurried, final. Not a sell

voice.note: The commercial's final recipe: one Gemini request per line, one voice and one delivery instruction, the gate selecting by shot fit among contour-passing draws, the clean chain with a +6 dB bell at 3.9 kHz whose gain is inside the voice trim.
